notes: Every vector row carries embedding_model_id, embedding_dim and embedding_version, with CHECK (vector_dims(embedding) = embedding_dim); a wrong-sized insert fails. Re-embed paths. (A) SAME dimension, new model: write new vectors with embedding_version = N+1 in batches (worker, resumable via the ledger), keep reads pinned to `embedding_version = <current>` from config, flip the config value when coverage is 100%, then delete old versions; a query never compares vectors from different versions. (B) DIFFERENT dimension: ADD COLUMN embedding_next vector(NEW_DIM), backfill, build the index/ANALYZE, then in ONE migration rename embedding_next -> embedding (and old -> embedding_prev), update embedding_dim default and the CHECK; drop embedding_prev after a soak. Graphiti keeps its own name/fact embeddings in Neo4j; changing the router's embedding model therefore ALSO requires re-embedding the graph (re-save nodes/edges through the namespace API) - plan that as one 'embedding generation' change, tracked in the ledger.
